title: Eric Hecker: Raytheon neutrino system under South Pole ice
summary: Steven Greer tells of Eric Hecker: Raytheon neutrino system under South Pole ice, about c. 2011 at Antarctica, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: South Pole, Antarctica; Christchurch, New Zealand

tellings.quote: came forward Eric Hecker a couple years ago who worked for Rathon and they were put in a nutrino light system a mile under the ice at the South Pole.
